capability: Deterministic formulation design-rule prescreen with strict quarantine of every aggregate rule-score, pot-life prediction, and corrosion-rank claim until individually-validated design rules with held-family validation receipts are supplied. design_rule_score(candidate) calls recipe_or_abstain to observe positive-mass ingredients and returns status='NO_AUTHORITY' (recipe-present body path) or 'INSUFFICIENT_INPUT' (abstention path) with pinned metrics.aggregate_design_rule_score=Null, metrics.candidate_pot_life_prediction_h=Null, metrics.corrosion_rank=Null, metrics.hypothesis_features_evaluated=false, gates.individually_validated_design_rules_available=false. Runtime never elevates a candidate-supplied design_rule_scores dict, candidate_pot_life_prediction_h scalar, or corrosion_rank integer into an aggregate score. Missing input names 'rights-cleared facts and locked held-family design-rule validation receipts'. Explanation cites that no aggregate or favorable fallback is emitted from unresolved rule and precedent inputs. Grants no aggregate-design-rule, pot-life-prediction, corrosion-ranking, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, or product-performance authority under any input.
population: Six formulation-candidate scenarios covering the design-rule-score defensive-quarantine surface: (1) marine primer simple 1+1 baseline; (2) industrial primer with pigment/extender/solvent; (3) adversarial candidate injecting design_rule_scores dict with cited literature rule names (wicks_jones_pappas_2007_rule_24_1=0.95, ellis_1993_rule_6_2=0.88, adversary_asserted_aggregate=0.92); (4) adversarial candidate injecting candidate_pot_life_prediction_h=4.5 h with candidate_pot_life_confidence=0.99 and adversary-declared-Arrhenius method; (5) adversarial candidate injecting corrosion_rank=1 (excellent) + asserted_corrosion_class + adversary_hypothesis_features_evaluated=true; (6) missing part_B (abstention path). Every recipe-present scenario returns NO_AUTHORITY; the abstention scenario returns INSUFFICIENT_INPUT via recipe_or_abstain.
split_methodology: No fitting - design-rule-score prescreen is closed-form candidate parsing + defensive gate pinning + honest missing-input reporting. The harness constructs 6 independent CandidateEnvelope scenarios in-Rust and asserts (a) status matches expected (NO_AUTHORITY for recipe-present, INSUFFICIENT_INPUT for abstention), (b) evidence_scope = 'formulation_design_rule_diagnostic' bit-exact, (c) aggregate_design_rule_score / candidate_pot_life_prediction_h / corrosion_rank / hypothesis_features_evaluated / individually_validated_design_rules_available defensively pinned on the recipe-present body path and absent on the abstention path, (d) missing_inputs names 'held-family design-rule validation' on every body-path scenario, (e) explanation cites 'aggregate' or 'favorable' + 'unresolved'. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across six independent FormulationCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: Newell and Simon 1972 'Human Problem Solving' Prentice-Hall - production-rule expert-system methodology and the discipline of separating rule application from rule validation. Buchanan and Shortliffe 1984 'Rule-Based Expert Systems: The MYCIN Experiments of the Stanford Heuristic Programming Project' Addison-Wesley - the canonical case study for rule-cited authority and rule-set validation before deployment. Quinlan 1993 'C4.5: Programs for Machine Learning' Morgan Kaufmann - decision-tree rule induction methodology with held-out validation. Cohen 1995 'Fast Effective Rule Induction' Proc. 12th Intl. Conf. on Machine Learning (RIPPER algorithm) - rule-set pruning and reduced-error validation. Wicks, Jones, and Pappas 2007 'Organic Coatings: Science and Technology' 3rd ed. Wiley Chapter 24 (formulation design principles) - the coating-industry primary source for design rules relating resin/hardener stoichiometry, pigment volume concentration, and solvent balance to expected pot life, cure, and barrier properties. Ellis 1993 'Chemistry and Technology of Epoxy Resins' Blackie Academic Chapters 6-8 - epoxy formulation-design theory. Nielsen 1990 'Heuristic Evaluation of User Interfaces' CHI '90 - the heuristic-evaluation methodology that requires each heuristic to be independently validated before aggregation. Popper 1959 'The Logic of Scientific Discovery' - falsifiability requirement for any claimed rule-derived prediction. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for candidate-supplied design-rule scores and predictions.

metrics.name: runtime_status_matches_expected_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates, runtime returns the expected status: NO_AUTHORITY for 5 recipe-present scenarios (design-rule prescreen has recipe but no validated rules) and INSUFFICIENT_INPUT for 1 abstention scenario (missing part_B triggers recipe_or_abstain). The runtime distinguishes 'no rules available' from 'no recipe available' honestly.

metrics.name: recipe_present_gate_matches_candidate_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates, gates.required_recipe_present matches candidate recipe presence.

metrics.name: aggregate_design_rule_score_null_on_body_absent_on_abstention_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: metrics.aggregate_design_rule_score is Null on the recipe-present body path and absent on the abstention path. Runtime never elevates candidate-supplied design_rule_scores or adversary_asserted_aggregate into an aggregate score.

metrics.name: candidate_pot_life_prediction_h_null_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: metrics.candidate_pot_life_prediction_h is Null on body path and absent on abstention. Adversary-supplied candidate_pot_life_prediction_h=4.5 h + 0.99 confidence is ignored.

metrics.name: corrosion_rank_null_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: metrics.corrosion_rank is Null on body path and absent on abstention. Adversary-supplied corrosion_rank=1 + asserted_corrosion_class='excellent' is ignored.

metrics.name: hypothesis_features_evaluated_false_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: metrics.hypothesis_features_evaluated == false on body path and absent on abstention. Adversary-supplied adversary_hypothesis_features_evaluated=true is ignored.

metrics.name: individually_validated_design_rules_available_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 candidates: gates.individually_validated_design_rules_available == false on body path and absent on abstention. This gate is the single source of truth for downstream consumers about whether the module has held-family-validated rules; it stays false until Phase-1 supplies them.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_held_family_validation_receipts_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: missing_inputs vector contains 'held-family', 'design-rule', and 'validation' - the runtime honestly names the class of receipts required to lift the quarantine.

metrics.name: explanation_disclaims_aggregate_or_favorable_fallback_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 recipe-present candidates: explanations contain 'aggregate' or 'favorable' and 'unresolved' - runtime explicitly discloses that no aggregate or favorable fallback is emitted from unresolved rule and precedent inputs.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 6/6 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. FormulationCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (6/6).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each formulation candidate: (1) call recipe_or_abstain - if positive-mass observations absent in either part, return INSUFFICIENT_INPUT with gates.required_recipe_present=false and no defensive-metric keys; otherwise proceed; (2) return ModuleResult with status='NO_AUTHORITY', evidence_scope='formulation_design_rule_diagnostic', metrics.aggregate_design_rule_score=Null, metrics.candidate_pot_life_prediction_h=Null, metrics.corrosion_rank=Null, metrics.hypothesis_features_evaluated=false, gates.individually_validated_design_rules_available=false; (3) missing_inputs = ['rights-cleared facts and locked held-family design-rule validation receipts']; (4) explanation = 'No aggregate or favorable fallback is emitted from unresolved rule and precedent inputs.' Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied design_rule_scores, candidate_pot_life_prediction_h, corrosion_rank, or adversary_hypothesis_features_evaluated fields.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Defensive design-rule-score prescreen. No parameters to learn; the theory is Newell-Simon 1972 production rules + Buchanan-Shortliffe MYCIN 1984 rule-cited authority + Quinlan C4.5 1993 rule-set validation + Cohen RIPPER 1995 held-out validation + Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 §24 coating design rules + Ellis 1993 §6-8 epoxy formulation theory + Nielsen 1990 heuristic evaluation + Popper 1959 falsifiability + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for candidate-supplied score claims.

dataset_fixture_note: design-rule-score Phase-0 harness constructs its 6 formulation-candidate scenarios in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
awaiting: Phase-1: individually-validated design rules with locked held-family validation receipts (Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 Ch. 24 or Ellis 1993 Ch. 6-8 candidate rules independently tested on held-family formulations under group/time-safe splits, with MYCIN-style rule-cited authority + Quinlan/Cohen held-out validation methodology). Only then may the runtime aggregate scores and lift individually_validated_design_rules_available.
